name: @tebos/web
description: TEBOS operator interface. Talks to the tebos-core database under the signed-in user's session; row-level security and the schema's rules are the enforcement point.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && vite build --config vite.tepos.config.ts && vite build --config vite.pra.config.ts && node scripts/check-bundles.mjs
scripts.build:tepos: npm run typecheck && vite build --config vite.tepos.config.ts
scripts.build:pra: npm run typecheck && vite build --config vite.pra.config.ts
